name: Lavaforged Spear
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 7th; Slot —; Price 13,244 gp; Weight 6 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Whenever this +1 obsidian-tipped spear is in an individual’s possession, it confers a constant +4 bonus on saves against death magic, negative energy attacks, and energy drain effects. Furthermore, once per day, as a free action after making a successful hit against a creature, the wielder can choose to deal an additional 1d8+3 points of fire damage. Finally, while wielding this spear, a creature gains fire resistance 10.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells death ward, resist energy, flame blade; Cost 6,622 gp
